configuration.startPort.description: Legacy reserved setting. Not used in the current Stdio mode.
configuration.autoStart.description: Automatically start the MCP service on startup.
configuration.licenseApiBase.description: Authorization service API base URL. Include prefixes such as /prod-api to match the RuoYi deployment path.
configuration.keepaliveEnabled.descripti: Enable keepalive polling while AI is idle and waiting for user messages. When disabled, AI conversations end naturally after timeout.
configuration.keepaliveMinutes.descripti: Keepalive timeout in minutes. Default is 45 minutes and can be adjusted from 1 to 120.
configuration.notifyOnReply.description: Show a system notification when AI replies. When enabled, Windows desktop notifications are shown even if Cursor is minimized.
configuration.bridgeEnabled.description: Enable remote bridge control, allowing AI Agent control through chat tools such as WeChat or Feishu.
configuration.bridgeChannel.description: Channel number bound to the remote bridge.
configuration.bridgeBotToken.description: Telegram Bot Token for remote bridge. Create a bot with @BotFather in Telegram to obtain it.
configuration.webServerEnabled.descripti: Enable browser access. When enabled, open http://localhost:<port> for core MCP operations such as sending messages, viewing channels, and receiving replies. Data is shared with the Cursor extension. Bound to 127.0.0.1 for local access only.
configuration.webServerPort.description: Browser service listening port. If occupied, the extension automatically tries port +1 up to 10 times.
